title: Organization invitations: a signed-in invitee who opens an already-accepted invitation gets the same not-found answer as an unknown id
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nWoa1Ze1QzjRTSYXD

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding with a named producer, from the #33650 os-dev report (6890090496, `out_of_scope_findings` class a). The #33650 contract record on PR #33679 (6890217201) asks for it to be filed before that PR lands. It was read on the vendor code by the dev, not driven live.
Reader: `domain:server` (plugin-auth, organization invitations). Grade p3, self-graded by the seat under the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」. The console already shows a sentence that covers the accepted case, so nothing breaks; the person just isn't taken into the organization they already joined.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open invitation accepted already member get-invitation` finds only #33650.

## 维护者速读

被邀请人接受邀请后再次打开同一个邀请链接（或接受后刷新页面），服务端返回的和「邀请不存在」完全一样，控制台无法知道「你已加入该组织」，只能显示一句通用提示「该邀请已被使用、已过期或已撤销」。#33650 的期望「已加入就直接带他进去」需要服务端给出区分。

## Producer

- better-auth 1.7.12 `GET /organization/get-invitation` (`dist/plugins/organization/routes/crud-invites.mjs`, `getInvitation`) refuses every invitation whose status is not `pending` with the same code-less `400 "Invitation not found!"` it gives an unknown id.
- `list-user-invitations` returns `pending` invitations only.
- objectstack's signed-out `invitation-preview` answers one uniform 404 by design (ADR-0138 D2), so it cannot help either.
- The console (PR #33679) therefore words the not-found sentence to cover used / expired / revoked and points to the organization list.

## Expected

When the signed-in person opening an invitation link is the invitation's own recipient and has already accepted it, the server answers so the console can show "you have joined <organization>" with a way in. For anyone else, or a signed-out caller, the answer is unchanged, so it reveals nothing the uniform 404 / not-found hides today (ADR-0138 D2).

## Acceptance

- Measure first: the vendor answer for accepted / rejected / canceled / expired and for an unknown id, signed in as the recipient and as someone else.
- A signed-in recipient's already-accepted invitation gets a distinguishable answer (a code, or a field on a successful read) naming the organization. Every other caller and state reads as today. Pins for both, with a CONTROL for a non-recipient.
- If this changes a refusal code or a response shape, the PR declares Clause-② and the console follow-up (showing the joined state) is filed as a `domain:ui` card.
- ⛔ No better-auth patch unless the server lane rules one in.

Refs #33650
